_comment: RDY-COST-01 — per-item consumer install-footprint budget (readiness layer 11). Baselines from `node scripts/check-cost.mjs --report`, with headroom to catch a significant balloon (AUDIT §5.7: one small item pulling in a whole chain) without tripping on routine growth. Overrides MERGE over default. Raise a number only DELIBERATELY, when a chain legitimately grew — the diff is the alarm.
